_comment: Recipient map for the Keep workspace-card writer (F-direction, dev/scripts/google_keep_card_writer.jl). Each recipient = (user x devices) reachable through a delegated Keep subject; card_query answers what that recipient sees. v1: sam x android/browser only - Moos/Lola/Menno engines have no Google Workspace identities yet (deferred; future rows, not code changes). Real tokens stay in secrets/, never here.
